title: Network connectivity troubleshooting
steps: 1. Confirm Wi-Fi is enabled. 2. Disconnect and reconnect to the network. 3. Restart the router only if authorized. 4. Check gateway/DNS status or contact IT.

title: Password and account access
steps: 1. Confirm the correct username and sign-in page. 2. Use the organization's approved password-reset portal. 3. Never share passwords or verification codes. 4. Contact IT if the account remains locked.

title: Printer troubleshooting
steps: 1. Check power and paper. 2. Confirm the selected printer. 3. Clear stuck jobs if permitted. 4. Check network connection and contact IT if the printer remains unavailable.

title: Software installation troubleshooting
steps: 1. Confirm the software is approved. 2. Check available storage and the installer error. 3. Verify permissions with IT. 4. Do not bypass organization security controls.

title: Slow or freezing computer
steps: 1. Save work. 2. Close unnecessary applications. 3. Record any error message. 4. Ask IT to review resource usage and system logs.

title: General IT triage
steps: 1. Record the exact symptoms and any error message. 2. Note when the problem started. 3. Identify whether others are affected. 4. Contact IT support with these details.
